title: Rank-one compactness comparison injective
statement: For any ring S in universe w, with the indicated derived category and coproducts, and any family E indexed by I : Type (max w vH), the canonical additive map from the direct sum of Hom(P,E i) to Hom(P,coproduct E) is injective, where P is the degree-zero single complex on ModuleCat.of S (ULift.{vH} S).

proof.text: For each i form the coproduct projection that is identity at i and zero elsewhere. Direct-sum induction shows that postcomposition with it recovers coordinate i of the input. Equality of images therefore implies coordinatewise equality.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: biproduct and module coproduct APIs, no matching theorem. The projection argument proves injectivity directly.

No public duplicate. CompactHomHocolim has a private coordinate calculation, which additionally assumes compactness; injectivity is proved here without that assumption.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedModule_rankOne_comparison_injective
    {S : Type w} [Ring S]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{max w vH} (ModuleCat.{max w vH} S)]
    [HasCoproducts.{max w vH} (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max w vH} S))]
    (I : Type (max w vH))
    (E : I → DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max w vH} S)) :
    let _ := Classical.decEq I
    let P := (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max w vH} S) 0).obj
      (ModuleCat.of S (ULift.{vH} S))
    Function.Injective
      (DirectSum.toAddMonoid (fun i : I => Preadditive.rightComp P (Sigma.ι E i)) :
        (⨁ i : I, (P ⟶ E i)) →+ (P ⟶ ∐ E))
